description: Get ready-to-run commands to launch the FULL live editor (flip / mix / compare directions in a real browser) — for when the headless screenshots aren't enough and the human wants to drive it themselves. Detects the project's dev command. In a LOCAL session these run in the agent's/human's terminal here; in a REMOTE/container session the result reframes them as commands for the human's OWN machine after pulling the branch (never a localhost URL handoff the human can't reach — pass `remote` to override detection).

projectDir.description: Absolute path to the user's project root (any framework — Next.js, Vite, Astro, Remix, SvelteKit, TanStack, …).

remote.description: Set true if you're a cloud/container agent whose human CANNOT open localhost URLs on this machine (auto-detected for common clouds — Claude Code on the web, Codespaces, Gitpod, Codex cloud; pass explicitly to override either way).

name: font_lab_live_instructions
